QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] The Deluded King
QuestInfo.0: Will #p2161000# change his mind when you remind him of his memory with the Queen? Ask Queen #p2161001#.
QuestInfo.1: #p2161001# found the #t4032837# which she made with #p2161000# in the rose garden a long time ago. She is certain that it will change Von Leon's mind. She says he will believe #p2161001# then. Go back to the #bAudience Room#k.
QuestInfo.2: You showed him the #t4032837#, but #p2161000# is angry that you touched his belongings. It doesn't seem like he'll believe anything you say. According to #p2161001#, he was a nice, romantic person. What changed him like this?

0.0: I found the Flower Book from my memories with Leon in the rose garden. Neither of us was talented enough to make it pretty, but we had fun making it. Please give this to Leon.

yes.0: If you show him the #t4032837# Leon and I made so long ago, he will know that I am still waiting for him as a ghost. Please, I'm counting on you. Return to the #bAudience Room#k...

no.0: I'm sorry...is it too much to ask?

1.0: You again! Why would you return? That... That's the #t4032837# I made with #p2161001#! Where did you get that!\r\n#L0##bI told you. I met #p2161001#. She's a ghost, but she's still waiting for you. She asked me to find the #t4032837# in the rose garden and show it to you.#l\n#k
1.1: Don't lie! She's dead. She passed away long ago. If you can hear her voice, why can't I? Do not speak #p2161001#'s name. Ever!

npc.0: Have you not gone to see him yet? You'll find him in the #bAudience Room#k. All alone...

item.0: You again? What is it this time? If it's about #b#p2161001##k, keep your mouth shut. I won't tolerate any more of your lies.
